content_sections.heading: SGOU Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification invites anticipated vacancies for the posts of Section Officer and Assistant Registrar on a contract basis.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply. Experience in ODL mode of Education. Proficiency in digital file processing, Office automation tools, e tendering, GeM procurement process. Experience in NAAC, NIRF, KIRF accreditation process.

rows.qualification_required: A Bachelor Degree from a Recognized University. AND Retired from the post of Section Officer or above in any recognized State and Central Universities, National Institutions, recognized Autonomous Educational Institutions and Deemed Universities.

A Bachelor Degree from a Recognized University. AND Retired from the post of Assistant Registrar or above in any recognized State and Central Universities, National Institutions, recognized Autonomous Educational Institutions and Deemed Universities.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Upper age limit is not more than 60 years as on 01/01/2026, with usual relaxation to SC/ST and OBC.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection shall be made by a duly constituted Selection Committee as per the University Act & Statutes. Short-listing may be based on academic record, teaching experience/research/academic score and ODL-relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGOU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply online through the University recruitment portal at https://sgou.ac.in. Fill in all particulars and upload legible copies of the required documents. After successful online submission, take a printout of the completed application. Affix a photograph, sign it, and attach self-attested copies of all credentials. Send the application by post to: The Registrar, Sreenarayanaguru Open University, Kureepuzha, Kollam, Kerala. Superscribe the envelope with 'Application for the post of Section Officer & Assistant Registrar'.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation / Higher Secondary certificate (proof of date of birth). Marksheets and degree certificates of Bachelor's Degree. Caste / PwBD certificate in the prescribed format (issued by competent authority), where claimed. Copy of P.P.O and Service Certificate.

content_sections.heading: SGOU Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must ensure that they fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the last date of receipt of application. Mere issue of an admit/interview memo does not confer eligibility. All degrees and qualifications must be from a University/Institution recognized by the State/Central Government. Canvassing in any form or bringing external influence will lead to disqualification. Only natives of Kerala shall be eligible for the reservation benefits. Defective/late applications will be summarily rejected. Any dispute shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts at [Kollam], [Kerala].

faq.question: Q1. What is SGOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SGOU Recruitment 2026 is an official notification issued by Sreenarayanaguru Open University to appoint Section Officer and Assistant Registrar posts on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SGOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification states that the number of vacancies is anticipated.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for SGOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission of applications is 11/11/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date for receipt of hard copies of the application?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the application must be received on or before 18/11/2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Section Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor Degree from a Recognized University and must have retired from the post of Section Officer or above in any recognized State and Central Universities, National Institutions, recognized Autonomous Educational Institutions and Deemed Universities.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for Assistant Registrar?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor Degree from a Recognized University and must have retired from the post of Assistant Registrar or above in any recognized State and Central Universities, National Institutions, recognized Autonomous Educational Institutions and Deemed Universities.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for SGOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not more than 60 years as on 01/01/2026, with usual relaxation to SC/ST and OBC.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary for Section Officer?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay for Section Officer is Rs. 38,590/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary for Assistant Registrar?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay for Assistant Registrar is Rs. 41,900/-.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Selection is made by a duly constituted Selection Committee, and short-listing may be based on academic record, teaching experience/research/academic score, and ODL-relevant experience.
